correction: On a private instance a release asset is not anonymously reachable, and the refusal is quiet: an unauthenticated GET of the asset URL can answer 200 with the sign-in page, while the API route answers 401 or 404. A read-back that judges by status code accepts a login page as a successful download, so it must compare the bytes (size and SHA-256) and never the status.
